title: Chapter 770
paragraphs: Chapter 770
Episode 189. Rolling In Luck (4)
Knights and warriors pursue different paths fundamentally from mages.
The ultimate goal of a warrior can be said to be solely greater strength, but most mages are more interested in exploring the mysteries of the world rather than power.
That's why so many mages are requesting to transfer simply upon seeing the name 'Hister', a legendary magic family.
To mages who know what 'Record Magic' is, the existence of Hister itself was the key leading to the end of the mystery.
Despite the fact that Hister's active period wasn't as long compared to other prestigious families and most of its history has been lost, that fact remained unchanged.
Suddenly, Jin thought of the promotional billboards that Valeria said she had installed all over the world.
A smirk crossed his face as he remembered the picture of her fresh, uncharacteristic smile, complete with a wink.
"Why are you laughing?"
"I was reminded of your promotional image. Looking at the list, it seems like there are well over a hundred."
"This is only a list of engineers among the magic scholars, and only those who are professors or higher. Over two thousand applications came in."
"Two thousand? That far exceeds my expectations."
"And they're still coming in like a flood."
If Valeria had been affiliated with Zipple and the world wasn't as turbulent as it is now, many times more applications would have come in.
"It's not just me, it's also thanks to Lord Leuth's existence being known. Lord Leuth is also using the name of Hister now."
Jin did not intentionally hide her existence after bringing Leuth.
Rather, he announced that Runcandel was protecting the new survivor of the Hister family.
There was no need to pay attention to Zipple's reaction, and strictly speaking, it was not false information.
Instead of recognizing that Valeria had lied about being the last survivor, the public had a more positive reaction, glad that a new Record Mage had appeared.
Of course, both Zipple and Kinzelo either know or suspect Leuth's identity.
However, Zipple cannot provoke Jin rashly, and Kinzelo is rather on his side.
Especially Orgal, he was hoping that when Leuth's memory returns, it would be easier to find clues about Lokia.
"Are there any particular individuals worth noting among those listed here?"
"There's one person. His name is Syal Rutber."
"That's a name I've never heard before."
"He's a low-ranking nobleman from the Kingdom of Faelin, a marginal engineer from one of Faelin's three universities, and he's 33 years old."
Faelin's three universities weren't particularly well known among magic engineers.
"If he's on the list of top-tier engineers, does he have some special abilities?"
"We'll verify that from now on. I've seen stories about Rutber in the Hister family records I've opened over the years."
The Rutber that Valeria saw in the records had once formed a brief alliance with Hister.
However, only a record of the alliance breaking remained, and the details could not be confirmed.
However, as a person from Rutber submitted an application amid all this, Valeria couldn't help but be curious.
As Valeria explained this, Jin nodded his head.
"If the family was capable of forming an alliance with Hister at that time, as you said, the fact that Rutber now has no influence might be related to Zipple."
"I think so too. My ancestors didn't leave any hostile impressions about Rutber. So I've inquired about people from Rutber before coming in, and here we found one. Let's go meet him together."
The two of them rode a Red Owl towards the outskirts of the city where Faelin's three universities are located.
With the makeup prepared on board for the Goldfinch race, they disguised themselves and immediately went to find the university, they were able to meet Syal quickly.
"Who are you two... You've come to see me?"
"I am Jin Runcandel. This is Valeria Hister."
"Excuse me?"
When he took off his wig and hastily wiped off his makeup, Syal was taken aback and his mouth fell open in surprise.
"Oh, oh! It's really you!"
Although no one asked him to, Syal first locked the door to the lounge, and then deeply bowed.
"I'm Syal Rutber who applied for the alliance this time! It's an honor for you two to come see me. Did you come after researching about my family's past?"
"Tell us first. How did Rutber and Hister become allies in the past, and why did it fall apart?"
Syal gauged Jin and Valeria's reactions.
"Speak freely. Whatever you say, we won't harm you."
Valeria also nodded. Even if Rutber had betrayed Hister in the past, it wouldn't have had a significant impact on the situation. If it had, Zipple wouldn't have left Rutber alone like this.
"I understand, Lord Jin. But you just said our family and Hister were allies in the past... what I know is a bit different."
"How is it different?"
"My late grandparents and parents always used to say this. Thanks to the Hister family, our Rutber family survived, and we must repay them one day."
"We survived thanks to our family...?"
As Valeria spoke, Syal nodded.
"Yes, our Rutber family is a regular one. However, one of our ancestors who was active in the 1400s was said to have a special talent in magical engineering. His name was Zen Rutber."
Zen Rutber was also a character not known to the public.
However, Valeria remembered the name Zen from the family records. He was the one who formed the alliance with Hister.
"At the time, it seems Zen received some kind of request from Hister. It was a request to make something, and I heard he worked on the development with Hister for a while."
"Do you know exactly what it was?"
"That... it's a story that's been handed down in the family like a legend. I heard it was an object that allowed long-distance communication."
Upon hearing that, Jin and Valeria felt a lightbulb go off in their heads.
A long-distance communication device.
It was an object closely related to the 'wave tracking summoning' that Valeria and Kwaol are currently developing.
All devices involving the term 'wave tracking' were like that.
Currently, Kwaol and Valeria are developing all items related to it in order to summon the Ruler clan of Lafrarosa in return for a favor.
One of the results was the red sphere that made limited merging possible, and what they were developing was the long-distance communication device.
If a direct summoning is difficult, the first step is to create a means to have real-time conversations with Lafrarosa.

"To be honest, I thought that was just a story that had been exaggerated over time. But seeing how the world is turning these days, I think it might have been real. Especially since technological advancement has been rapidly taking place since chaos has arrived in the world. Most of all, seeing the record magic makes me even more convinced."
"A long-distance communication device... You're saying Hister requested that from your ancestor."
"Yes."
"Is there any more information passed down about that? Like whether it was completed or any technical documents."
"My grandparents and parents believed it would have been completed and hidden somewhere."
"So there's no tangible evidence then?"
This time Valeria asked, and Syal smiled awkwardly.
"... I do have this. It's a piece of paper that Zen is said to have left behind, and it's a family heirloom."
Syal spoke as he undid the pendant he had around his neck.
Inside the pendant was a single sheet of paper, folded many times, which was so old and stained that it looked like garbage.
As Syal unfolded the paper, sentences made up of codes were revealed.
And Jin had seen the same cipher before.
The magic book of Shuziel Hister, acquired from the Teshing underground auction.
The cipher on Syal's paper perfectly matched the cipher system written in the magic book.
Valeria's pupils dilated when she saw the encrypted text.
"May I take a closer look?"
"Feel free."
The deciphered message Valeria read contained the following:
<May 12, 1457, with the help of the great magical engineer Zen Rutber, we have finally succeeded in developing a communication device.

However, since we cannot handle the enemies targeting this device and its blueprint, we decided to hide the device in the heritage of Malliet Hister. It is the only way to prevent the extinction of the Rutber family.
It is painful that Zen's achievement will be forgotten for a long time, as we were unable to fully use the completed device.
Zen Rutber thankfully agreed with my opinion. Despite having to say goodbye to his family because of us. Ah! Zen, thank you once again for your great judgement and sacrifice.
All the knowledge and achievements of Zen Rutber, his soul and my body, even the soul....
They will remain in Malliet's heritage. If the enemies cannot find it, it will stay there forever.
Therefore, my descendant who reads this letter, find the heritage of Malliet.
I left the location of Malliet's heritage on the back of this letter.
It's a heritage with a very bad reputation among record mages, so make sure to challenge it only after acquiring enough skills.>
According to the paper, the communication device Zen Rutber made with Hister was already completed in the 1400s.
Moreover, Zen of Rutber did not betray Hister, rather, it's like Hister owes him a great debt.
Valeria, calming her pounding heart, scanned the paper several times.
And she shared its contents with Jin and Syal.
"……The legend of the family was really true."
"Rather, contrary to the legend, if the content of this paper is proven to be true, I, the enemy of Hister, should express my gratitude and give compensation."

"Oh, you don't have to think like that. It's not me, it's something my ancestor did. I just want to work as a member of the Vamel Alliance. Even if there was no paper left by my ancestor, I would have applied to the alliance as a magical engineer."
Jin and Valeria nodded and smiled.
It was not enough that the contractor of the god of architecture suddenly appeared, and the top-tier magical engineers came, now even the legacy of Hister and Zen. Good luck was coming in succession.
"We will give you a proper reward as soon as the verification is over at Malliet's heritage, Syal. Let's head to Tikan first."
At Valeria's words, Syal hopped up and showed a happy expression.
